paragraphs.text: Queen Miralda the Pious is the iron-fisted ruler of Torrezon .

Miralda is the highest leader of the Legion of Dusk , who sent them to Ixalan to collect the Immortal Sun , and the Queen's Bay Company , whose mission was to uncover the temple of Aclazotz . While little is known directly of Queen Miralda's appearance or personality, it can be inferred by her underlings' actions and communications that Miralda is a strong-willed and persistent advocate of obtaining the Immortal Sun from Ixalan .
